name: ComfyUI · Wan 2.2 5B (draft)
licence_note: Wan2.2-TI2V-5B (Wan-AI), the UMT5-XXL text encoder and the Wan2.2 VAE are Apache-2.0; the single-file repackage (Comfy-Org/Wan_2.2_ComfyUI_Repackaged) is Apache-2.0 too. You are responsible for generated content.
notes: Fast-ish draft clips from the 5B text/image-to-video model: one KSampler (20 steps, uni_pc, cfg 5), Wan22ImageToVideoLatent (optional start image), CreateVideo + SaveVideo (H.264 MP4). Core nodes only. The negative prompt is Wan's own default (Chinese); a Studio job only replaces it when you type one.
estimate_note: Measured on the RTX 5070 Ti (16 GB) with ComfyUI v0.45.3, cold models, nothing else on the GPU; vram_gb = peak VRAM of the ComfyUI process (dynamic VRAM uses what is free).
